design_archetype: Performance Pro / Electric Cyber Control Center
theme: Dark Mode First (with glassmorphism, glowing micro-accents, tactical precision)

header.style: Sticky glassmorphic top bar with backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/60 z-40)
header.mobile: Top-left 3-line Hamburger icon button (data-testid='mobile-menu-trigger'), centered brand logo + name ('Telegram Ultra'), and quick actions or status dot
header.desktop: Brand logo + 'Telegram Ultra' title & subtitle on left, real-time agent status badge in center, and Sign Out button on right with confirmation modal

navigation.desktop_tabs: Horizontal glass segmented bar with rounded-xl padding, subtle hover transitions, active background indicator, badges, and Lucide icons (Users, UserPlus, Radio, Eye, Vote, Smile, UserCog, Trash2, MessageSquare)
navigation.mobile_sidebar: Slide-in sheet from top-left (data-testid='mobile-nav-sheet') with Telegram Ultra header, status overview, nav items list with active state highlights, and full sign-out option at the bottom

sections.userbots_accounts: Grid layout with search/filter toolbar, add/import/buy CTA buttons, account status summary metrics, and responsive cards with live ping, phone, proxy, and action menus
sections.data_heavy_tables: Dense tactical tables with horizontal scrolling on mobile, explicit column widths, status badges, monospaced proxies/IDs, and accessible pagination/actions
sections.form_panels: Clean structured cards with clear field labels, helper text, inline validations, input group icons, and tactile primary buttons

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg buttons with subtle scale on click (active:scale-[0.98]), clear hover states, explicit text color, and loading spinner states
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle border with inner glow, backdrop blur or solid carbon surface, rounded-xl radius, and p-4 to p-6 inner padding
component_guidelines.badges: Status badges with pulsing live indicators (green for Active/Online, red for Offline/Banned, amber for Processing/Pending)
component_guidelines.dialogs: Elevated modal dialogs with semi-transparent dark backdrop blur (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md) and clear header/footer actions
component_guidelines.inputs: Tactile dark input fields with border-border/80 focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/30 text-sm font-mono for technical fields

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Never center-align body text or dense form controls; keep left-aligned for natural reading order.
Do not use generic raw Inter or default unstyled components for headlines; use Outfit/Geist with tight tracking.
Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 for standard text).
Mobile layout MUST provide smooth touch targets (minimum 44x44px for buttons and hamburger triggers).
Active tab states must be clearly visual both in desktop tab bar and mobile slide-in menu.
Always rename product references from 'Telegram Pro' to 'Telegram Ultra' across all components, titles, aria-labels, and dialog text.
Micro-interactions: include smooth hover transforms, color shifts, and active press states for all interactive elements.
